note: View-keeping descent of the fast race-cue pilot, version 2: version 1's view rule unchanged (the descent_view block has the same values) plus contact support (haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.ContactSupportConfig; visual_brain --descent-view on|off|DECLARATION, off by default; the runner flies only this version and refuses version 1, kept as configs/pilot/descent_view_v1.json). Why version 2: the round-4 review found, and minus-fast6-r4-02 showed live, that version 1's sink bound keeps the pilot's sink request above about -0.8 m/s below about 5 m/s, while both older support rules need a command below -0.8 m/s: the drone lay on the Minus Two garage floor at 27.4-28.9 s (command -0.3..-0.5 m/s) with no support climb. Contact support reads the ground reaction instead: the vertical specific force that the thrust of the issued throttle (the measured thrust curve of runs/measured-dynamics-low-speed-20260923/profile.json, sha256 266d40b4d777194cd774eef741df8d773250f6278955554e48bd3002b0b924b5: full_input_twr, exponent, translation_drag_s_inv), gravity and drag cannot explain, while the command asks to sink and the drone does not follow it. Generic and course-agnostic: measured velocity and attitude, the issued throttle and the pad calibration; no height above ground, no course geometry, no per-course value. Values were chosen on development evidence only (contact_support_development): the live logs (every one of them is a development case for this rule, the round-4 live logs included), the review's resting scenario with motors, a floor scenario in the nominal surrogate and surrogate development seeds (flat:5000-5007, steep:5000-5007, hill:6100-6111), before the frozen gates (configs/pilot/contact_support_gates.json) and before any run of the gate seeds (flat:3000-3007, steep:3000-3007, hill:6000-6011) with this rule. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze, and every version is reported. Surrogate results, scenarios and open-loop replays are development evidence, never flight evidence.

descent_view_notes.view_bound: the pilot's own requested sink is bounded so that the flight path made of the measured horizontal velocity and the requested vertical speed points margin_deg (3 deg; cue_margin_deg 3 deg while the ring is in view) inside the camera's lower image edge at the measured attitude: exact projection through the calibrated camera, roll included (y/z <= tan(atan(cy/f) - margin) is linear in the vertical speed). With a level nose that is a path of 9 deg down at any speed; a nose-up (braking) drone may sink less, a hovering drone at most free_sink (0.3 m/s, a gentle touch at worst). The lowest in-view vertical speed per 1 m/s of horizontal speed is low-passed with attitude_time_constant (1 s): with the unfiltered attitude (and with 0.3 s) fast-brain-08's pitch and the bound formed a 0.6-1 Hz limit cycle in the development runs. A requested climb is never changed
descent_view_notes.keep_speed: below_speed_fraction 1: a bottom-clipped ring keeps the speed schedule (the default pilot halves it; that brake lifted the nose and the lower image edge on the Straw downhill). The descent-path governor is not fed while the bound withholds sink (a withheld sink is no shortfall) and never cuts below descent_min_scale (0.75; the default floor 0.35 held straw-brain08-01 on the hillside)
descent_view_notes.more_speed: while the bound withholds sink toward a ring ahead (states cue, below, below_weak) the horizontal request rises toward the speed schedule's, fully once boost_sink (0.3 m/s) is withheld; never above the declared speed (the brain contracts refuse more)
descent_view_notes.throttle_up: the requested sink grows at up to sink_acceleration (2.5 m/s^2 instead of the pilot's 5 m/s^2 slew), so a descent does not start with a deep throttle cut (the brain issued 0.3-0.35 below hover on the Straw descents)
descent_view_notes.steep_late: a ring that stays clipped below for more than late_after_s (0.75 s of the pilot's unbroken bottom clip) lies more steeply below than a steady view allows; the margin then falls at late_rate_deg_s (6 deg/s) down to late_max_deg (20 deg) below the lower image edge: a steep leg is flown shallow first (in view over a convex crest after the upper checkpoint) and steep late. Without it (a strict bound) the development runs overflew steep lower rings by up to 8 m and circled back (fast PD 2 -> 17-19 passes more than 1.5 m above a checkpoint, fast-brain-08 1 -> 18); with it the fast PD reached them more often (6) and faster. It is the part of the rule that points the path below the image, and only on legs steeper than the view
descent_view_notes.interactions: order in FastRaceCue.update: the pilot's request (search, launch and launch-surface rules first), then the view bound, then the descent-path governor, the speed rise and the support rule, then the looming governor and the vertical guard (which see the bounded request as the pilot's own), turn-first and the command slews. Search (no sink), launch and support climbs are unchanged; the slope-support rule needs a request below -0.8 m/s, which the bound allows only above about 5 m/s: a slow drone resting on a slope is not recognised by it. The rise toward the speed schedule is still capped by the looming governor's wall cap and by turn-first, which act later
descent_view_notes.brain_limit_found: fast-brain-08 does not keep 6 m/s while it sinks: asked for (6 m/s, -1.8 m/s) it flew about (3.0, -1.05) in the development runs, where asked for (3, -1.8) by the default pilot it tracked the request; its distillation data paired descents with the default pilot's half speed. With this rule it therefore descends shallower than asked and passes lower checkpoints high (1 -> 15 on the development hills) although its contacts fell 13 -> 3. A brain distilled under this pilot is the expected fix, not a pilot value

contact_support_notes.thrust_model: thrust_twr, thrust_exponent and body_drag_s_inv are the measured profile's full_input_twr, exponent and translation_drag_s_inv (the fast PD flies on the same curve). The live residual of the vertical specific force against it (10 logs, fast PD and brains, Minus Two, Pine Valley, Straw Bale): median -0.03..-0.08 m/s^2, p10..p90 about +-0.2 m/s^2 at a drive of 0.5-0.7; at a drive of 0.3-0.4 a median of +0.4..+3.7 m/s^2 (idle thrust, spin-down), hence drive_min 0.40 (a window with any tick below it is not used) and drive_max 0.80. throttle_delay_s 0.03: the calibrated processed throttle leads the measured acceleration by 2-4 frames
contact_support_notes.detection: unexplained = dvz/dt - (gain*mean(thrust*up_z) - g - mean(drag_z)) over window_s 0.3 s; a support climb (FastCueConfig.support_climb_s 0.6 s at >= 1 m/s, the older rules' climb) after hold_s 0.15 s of: command <= -sink_min 0.1 m/s, vz >= command + shortfall 0.1 m/s, vz <= rest_vz 0.5 m/s, unexplained >= unexplained_on 0.8 m/s^2. The older support rules stay as in version 1
contact_support_notes.arming: arm_after_s 3.2 s after the pilot's first tick: the runner holds the throttle for 1 s and ramps it until 3 s, so the issued throttle is not the game's before; never while launching
contact_support_notes.gain: gain starts at 1 (the measured vehicle) and follows the observed gain with gain_time_constant 1 s, each step's difference clipped to gain_step 0.15 (so it moves at most about 0.15 per second), within [gain_min 0.75, gain_max 1.3], on armed valid windows outside a contact episode and a support climb, when the unexplained force is at most gain_quiet 0.4 m/s^2 or the drone rises (the window's lowest vz >= gain_rising 0.05 m/s). On the logged flights (the rule's code on the logged motion, command and issued throttle) it stays within 0.95-1.10, except straw-brain6-02: an uphill scrape at 38.7-39.3 s (the drone climbing 1.2-1.35 m/s at a drive of 0.52-0.53, below hover, pushed up by the hill) raised it to 1.195; a gain that high hides about 1.9 m/s^2 of ground reaction at hover until quiet windows bring it back (about 1-1.5 s). The surrogate randomises twr and exponent by 10% each (a thrust gain of up to about +-20% at hover): without learning, a strong drone flying level with a brain motor that does not follow a small sink request looks like a drone resting on the ground (a draft that did not learn from rising windows fired twice on brain-08 steep:5001)
contact_support_notes.interactions: a support climb the rule starts is the older rules' support climb (state support_climb, climb_until); their timers are reset when it fires. The descent-path governor, the view bound, the vertical guard and turn-first are unchanged (turn-first hands off to support climbs as before)

contact_support_development.scope: development evidence only; the gates are frozen separately and scored afterwards
contact_support_development.resting_scenario: the review's case (ring clipped below, measured velocity (v, 0, 0) held, vz 0) after a 3.5 s level prologue: support climb 0.28 s after the rest begins at 0-6 m/s with the fast PD (drive_min 0.45 gave 0.66-0.82 s at 3-5 m/s: the PD's sink onset takes the drive to 0.40-0.45), 0.19-0.47 s with fast-brain-08, brain-09b and fast-brain-10b

contact_support_development.logs: the rule's code on every logged flight (logged commands and issued throttle): fires only on the Minus Two floor (minus-fast6-r4-02 at 27.67 and 29.32 s) and on the Straw Bale downhill contact spots (x -35..-39, y 133-174) of the brain-06/07/08 laps and the straw-brain08-01 slide (from 68.54 s, every 0.76 s); none on Pine Valley, the other Minus Two flights, the Straw uphill and hilltop or the fast-PD Straw laps. The full round-4 stack replayed on minus-fast6-r4-02 fires at 27.72 s

contact_support_development.attempts: round 4b ran in two attempts; the first was cut off before committing and its uncommitted draft was reused. First attempt (all development): the rule's code on every logged flight (all logs in runs/fast-stack-20260923, including the round-4 live logs), the resting and floor scenarios for all four motors, the surrogate on the development seeds only (flat:5000-5007, steep:5000-5007, hill:6100-6111; no gate seed), contact sheets of the labelled Straw Bale contacts, the straw-brain08-01 slide and the minus-fast6-r4-02 floor, and the draft contact audit on an unrecorded subset of logs. Second attempt, before the freeze: the minus-fast6-r4-02 replay (m4 stack as flown with this declaration: onsets 27.72 and 29.38 s), the resting scenario for the fast PD (0.28 s at 0-6 m/s) and fast-brain-10b (0.39-0.46 s), the rule's gain trace on straw-brain6-02. No value was changed by the second attempt
